name: excalidraw
description: Claude Code integration for the local Excalidraw MCP server: auto-registers the server, adds diagram-drawing guidance, and diagnoses common setup issues (stale builds, tenant mismatches, destructive auto-sync). Requires `pnpm run build` (or `npm run build`) to have been run at least once — dist/ is gitignored and not committed, so a fresh clone must be built before the MCP server can start; run /excalidraw:excalidraw-doctor to confirm.
